base_candidates_ranked.reason: The experiment used data-dependent acquisition (DDA) on an Orbitrap Eclipse Tribrid. While the primary quantification was done via aptamer sequencing, the MS was used for protein identification of pull-down eluates. No isobaric or SILAC labels were mentioned for the MS part.

modifier_candidates_ranked.reason: The proteins were specifically enriched using biotinylated RNA aptamers captured on streptavidin magnetic beads.
